name: @thirdlight/asset-pipeline
description: Thirdlight bounded GLB import pipeline (project-model.md §18.7/§18.8, dependencies.md §2/§3): pure glTF 2.0 GLB inspection over supplied bytes and the immutable import proposal + import recipe.
